title: Tiny Fuels
description: Adds tiny fuels to the game
body:
A small mod that adds tiny fuels to the game. Each tiny fuel smelts items at a 1 to 1 ratio, or less, and can be crafted back and forth between their normal and tiny forms. Currently includes tiny fuel for both coal and charcoal. Also includes compat for create processing.

Also includes smaller than tiny fuels, for even more precision burns.
